summary: Verified bug fix for POST /api/admin/sessions/toggle (decorator restored). Backend: 9/9 pytest passed. Endpoint returns 200 for both target=public and target=walkin (previously 404). GET /api/event correctly reflects status='open' after public toggle and walkin_open=true after walkin toggle, and reverts after close. admin2 (non-super) correctly gets 403. VIP regression: POST /api/admin/vip requires name (400 if empty), requires seats (400 if empty), rejects operator seats A11 (400), and successfully creates VIP order on L2 (session 2) with total_amount=0, vip=true, checked_in=false, status=verified, seats locked (duplicate lock -> 409). Bendahara regression: GET /api/admin/bendahara returns 200 with grand_total/by_date/orders; VIP order appears with channel='vip'. Frontend /admin (admin1): session-control-card renders 4 small session cards; toggling Umum & Panitia switches for S2/S4 shows success toast 'Sesi X DIBUKA/DITUTUP untuk Umum/Panitia (…)' with NO 'not found' error; switch aria-checked state flips correctly. VIP tab: select session 2, pick seat L2 via seatmap, fill name, submit -> success dialog vip-result appears with order #4334.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js has grown to ~1960 lines — still exceeds the <700-line guideline. Recommend splitting VIPPanel, BendaharaPanel, UsersPanel, TrashPanel into separate modules.

server.py toggle_session_open (L1221) has no explicit type validation for target values other than the model's Literal (SessionToggle); OK, but consider returning both open_sessions & walkin_sessions for FE consistency instead of only the touched key.

No permanent purge endpoint for orders exists (delete = soft-delete only); trash accumulates over time and cleanup requires direct DB access. Consider adding /api/admin/orders/{id}/purge for superadmin.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_VIP orders (backend test on L2/L3 S2, and one via UI on L2 S2 with order #4334). All hard-deleted from MongoDB + seat_locks freed after tests. Session toggles opened during tests were closed at the end.
final_state: Preview restored: coming_soon=ON; all 4 sessions closed for both public (open_sessions=[]) and walkin (walkin_sessions=[]). No lingering TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed: POST /api/admin/sessions/toggle decorator is present at server.py L1221 and returns 200. Route model SessionToggle uses Literal['public','walkin'] for target. Frontend toggle switches (data-testid session-open-switch-{id} and session-walkin-switch-{id}) call toggleSessionOpen at AdminPage.js L1186 which POSTs to /api/admin/sessions/toggle and shows toasts. VIP flow uses SeatMap component with data-testid='seat-{label}' selector; vip-submit disabled when name empty or no seats.
rca of the issue: Original bug: while adding VIP endpoint (@api_router.post('/admin/vip') at L1170), the developer accidentally removed the decorator @api_router.post('/admin/sessions/toggle') from toggle_session_open causing FastAPI to not register the route (404 Not Found). Fix: decorator restored at L1221. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/sessions/toggle used to return 404. Now returns 200 with correct behavior. Verified via pytest test_toggle_public_open_close_session1 and UI toggle in AdminPage session-control-card.
